text: $\overline{BC}=\,6\sqrt{3}$$\overline{OP}=\,\overline{OQ}$ 이므로 $\overline{AB}=\,\overline{AC}$ 이다.$\overline{AB}=\,\overline{AC}$와 $\angle BAC=\,60^\circ$으로 $\triangle ABC=$ 정삼각형으로$\overline{AB}=\,\overline{BC}=\,\overline{AC}$원 넓이가 $36\pi$ 이므로 원 $O$ 의 반지름 길이는 $6$$\overline{OA}=\,\overline{OB}=\,\overline{OC}=\,6$$\triangle \,APO=\triangle AQO\,(RHS$ 합동$)$,   $\angle \,OAP=\,30^\circ$$\cos 30^\circ =\,\frac{\mathrm{\sqrt{3}}}{2}=\,\frac{\overline{AP}}{\overline{OA}}=\,\frac{\overline{AP}}{6}\,$,   $\overline{AP}=\,3\sqrt{3}$$\overline{AB}=\,2\overline{AP}=\,6\sqrt{3}$$\overline{AB}=\,\overline{BC}=\,6\sqrt{3}$

$\triangle DBC=$  $9\sqrt{3}\,cm^{2}$$\overline{AD}$가 원 $O$ 의 지름이므로 $\triangle ABD=\,$직각삼각형.$\angle \,AB\,D=\,90^\circ$, $\angle \,ADB=60^\circ$,  $\overline{AD}=\,2\overline{AO}=\,12$$\cos 60^\circ =\,\frac{\mathrm{1}}{2}=\,\frac{\overline{BD}}{\overline{AD}}=\,\frac{\overline{BD}}{12}$,    $\overline{BD}=\,6$$\angle BAD=\,\angle DBC=\,30^\circ$$\angle \,ABC=\,\angle ABD\,+\,\angle \,DBC=\,90^\circ +30^\circ =\,120^\circ$$\triangle \,ABC$에서 $\angle C=\,30^\circ$$\triangle DBC=$이등변삼각형$\overline{DB}=\,\overline{DC}=\,6$                        $\triangle DBC=\,\frac{1}{2}\times \,\overline{DB}\,\times \,\overline{DC}\,\times \,\sin \angle BDC$$=\frac{1}{2}\times 6\times 6\times \,\sin 120^\circ $$=18\times \sin (180^\circ -120^\circ )$$=\,18\,\times \,\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$$=9\sqrt{3}$
